name: PVTA Senior Dial-A-Ride
description: Van service for seniors aged 60 and older throughout PVTA's 24 member communities (Amherst is a member community). There is no application: you register by calling the Van Service Reservation Office when you book your first trip.

requirements.text: Must be in one of PVTA's 24 member communities, which include Amherst.

unknowns: How far ahead trips must be booked
Whether senior van rides are free during FY27 (the van fares page says no fares or passes are needed for vans)
Service area set to Amherst ZIP codes: Amherst is the only PVTA member community confirmed from a fetched page.

guide.what: Van rides for adults 60 and older across PVTA's 24 member communities, including Amherst.

ways.title: Call to book your first ride
ways.detail: Van Service Reservation Office, 413-739-7436. They register you on the same call.

guide.no_documents_note: No application or documents are listed. You register by phone.
ask_them: What are the service hours in Amherst?
How far ahead do I need to book?
Are senior van rides free this year?

first_step.title: Book your first Senior Dial-A-Ride trip
first_step.detail: Call the Van Service Reservation Office at 413-739-7436. They register you on that call.
